notes.title: Official Demo Release
notes.notes: [p]The story of the Telluria: Forebodings demo was quite complicated.[/p][p align="justify"]To introduce our girls to the world, we initially chose to tell a prologue, a hint at what happened before the story we're about to tell. The first meeting, the first power, the enemies in the background, the two realities, the guiding characters, the arrival of the Talisman that will accompany us with its thousand-year-old story through the twists and turns of Adhar's curse.[/p][p align="justify"]All of this was then transformed into a self-contained adventure that we then decided to make into a standalone game, The Pyrite Talisman, recently remastered and adapted to the new graphics and the gradually evolving story. We then chose to produce the new demo by jumping directly into the main game, and so the introduction, the chapter we called "Sweet Twenties" in homage to April Ryan, will become the Telluria: Forebodings demo.[/p][p]The story has been reworked to be more accessible and comprehensive, with clues, characters, locations, and powers already developed. We're working on the music, adding Alessio Qemal Maiorani (Q3M) to the team, whose music will underscore our scenes. And of course, there will be the two Annelises, Tru and Bru, the mentor, Kyra and Odho, and all our settings. This will be the beginning of our journey on Telluria, and it will be fantastic to do it with all of you.[/p]
